name: Vor Deo
description: Vor Deo was an Outer Rim Territories trade world situated in the Arkanis sector. Located on the Old Corellian Run hyperlane and at the endpoint of the Cranan-Excarga Route, during the reign of the Galactic Empire, an increasing number of illegal cargoes smuggled to Vor Deo led the Imperial authorities to concentrate law enforcement efforts there.
